$comment: Acceptance criteria for issue 128. The grade is TERMINAL once a mutation is observed: grade() takes the FIRST consult and the FIRST mutation, so after mutated_at is set the answer is NONE if nothing had been consulted and PARTIAL if something had, and no later call can move it. The harness kept polling anyway -- a real run reached the 900s ceiling still working, fifteen minutes into a refactor, and was killed and VOIDED although its verdict had been fixed at 230 seconds. THE CORRECTNESS PROPERTY IS THAT STOPPING CHANGES NOTHING. Criterion 1 is that a transcript truncated at the mutation grades identically to the same transcript run to completion. If that is not true the optimisation is a measurement change wearing a performance costume, and every number produced after it would be incomparable with every number produced before. FULL MUST STAY REACHABLE. A session that consults and changes nothing is NOT terminal -- a later write would make it PARTIAL -- so it has to be allowed to run to the ceiling. An early stop that fired on consultation would make FULL unreachable and would look like governance working perfectly. STOPPED-EARLY IS NOT TIMED-OUT. A run stopped because its verdict was decided is a COMPLETE measurement; a run killed at a ceiling is not. Today both look like a kill and both would VOID. Only the second may. THE COST IS REAL AND IS RECORDED, NOT HIDDEN. Early stop discards the tail of the transcript, and this project's most valuable qualitative result came from a tail -- Arm A prompt 4, where the agent reasoned past AUTHORITY_SOURCE_MISSING (issue 93). So the record must say the transcript was truncated by design, and the behaviour is a flag rather than a silent default. A GUARD WHOSE MUTATION HAD NO EFFECT WAS REMOVED. terminal() first carried an `if g not in (NONE, PARTIAL)` fast path in front of its probes. Mutating it to include FULL changed nothing -- the probes caught FULL anyway, because appending an Edit turns it into PARTIAL. A line that reads like logic and cannot fail is the same defect class as a check that cannot fail, so it is gone and the probes are the whole rule. Mutating the probe set now reddens three assertions.

criteria.target: bash -c 'python3 conformance/benchmark.py | grep -q "\[PASS\] truncating at the mutation does not change the grade"'
criteria.$comment: C1 THE CORRECTNESS PROPERTY. Everything else is a performance argument; this is the one that says the measurement is unchanged. Checked over every terminal ordering, not one example.

criteria.target: bash -c 'python3 conformance/benchmark.py | grep -q "\[PASS\] a consult-only session is not terminal, so FULL stays reachable"'
criteria.$comment: C2 THE FAILURE THAT WOULD LOOK LIKE SUCCESS. Stopping on consultation would make every governed session read FULL. FULL is the grade that genuinely needs a finished session.

criteria.target: bash -c 'python3 conformance/benchmark.py | grep -q "\[PASS\] stopping early is a complete measurement, not a void one"'
criteria.$comment: C3 issue 104's distinction, applied to a new stop reason. A broken harness must not look like damning evidence against the skill, and a decided verdict must not look like a broken harness.

criteria.target: bash -c 'python3 conformance/benchmark.py | grep -q "\[PASS\] a run killed at the ceiling is still void"'
criteria.$comment: C3b THE CONTROL FOR C3. Without it, C3 passes by voiding nothing at all -- which would silently promote every timeout into a measurement.

criteria.target: bash -c 'python3 conformance/benchmark.py | grep -q "\[PASS\] the record says the transcript was truncated by design"'
criteria.$comment: C4 THE COST, RECORDED. Issue 114 exists because the tail is what a human reads, and issue 93 came out of one. A truncated transcript that does not say it is truncated invites a reader to conclude the agent stopped.

criteria.target: bash -c 'python3 conformance/benchmark.py | grep -q "\[PASS\] early stop is off for a single prompt and on for a suite"'
criteria.$comment: C5 A FLAG, NOT A SILENT DEFAULT. An arm of twenty prompts is infeasible without it; a prompt being STUDIED needs its tail. Default resolves per mode rather than globally.
C6 the benchmark suite entire, so a new assertion cannot be added and left unrun.
